title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature will enable yantraverse to handle JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to easily parse and access request data in their routes and middleware. This is a crucial feature for building robust and functional APIs. By adding request body parsing, yantraverse will become a more versatile and powerful framework
acceptance: Request body parsing should work correctly for JSON and URL-encoded data, and error handling should be implemented for invalid request bodies
reason: This feature is essential for building functional APIs and will significantly enhance the usability and capabilities of the yantraverse framework
